articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
articles.snippet: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

articles.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
articles.snippet: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.

articles.title: Polymarket trims workforce under investor pressure as Kalshi surges ahead
articles.snippet: More than half of those affected were contractors, a source told Reuters. The cuts follow investor pressure on founder Shayne Coplan.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

articles.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
articles.snippet: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.
